content: Anti-botting in Discord games (cross-checked: Pokétwo ToS/docs, Discord rate-limit docs): Pokétwo gates spawns on real chat activity (needs multiple non-bot users talking; messages from 2+ users count faster), has anti-spam that ignores bot messages, and explicitly bans selfbots/auto-catchers/spam-to-trigger-spawns as suspendable offenses. Discord's own rate limits (50 req/s global, ~5 msg/s per channel) are the hard platform ceiling. Pattern: make the source of encounters human-activity-gated so automation has no free tap; add cooldowns per user action; detect abnormal action velocity. Design implication: our travel+encounter loop should key encounter generation off genuine interaction and cap per-user action rates in Redis.
